accounting: Year 1 60 required. Year 2 40 required plus 5 EC in each of the two seminar terms and 10 EC excursion. Year 3 10 required research/publishing plus 10 EC selected seminar, 10 EC final paper and 30 open electives, shown as two 15 EC blocks. No double counting of alternatives.
progression: The current Leiden Study Guide lists two 180 EC formal routes. Arts and Culture is the broad historical route for the generic Art History target. Year one comprises 60 EC of required courses. Year two comprises 40 EC of required courses, one 5 EC seminar in each semester and one 10 EC excursion. The selected Art I and Art II seminars require Visual Analysis and Academic Skills II. The Florence excursion additionally requires a completed second-year seminar. Year three comprises 10 EC of required research and publishing study, one 10 EC seminar, the 10 EC final paper and 30 EC of open electives. The selected architectural preservation seminar requires the first year and both second-year seminars. The current Aesthetics course replaces the older module named in the research methods prerequisite. The final paper requires the first year, both second-year seminars and Perspectives on Art Historical Research. The ordinary final-paper offering is in the second semester. First-semester entry requires board approval.
